name: audit-input-and-pdf
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,hashlib,base64
w=Path('write_lane.py').resolve()
for f in ['input/author-guard-access-inventory.json','input/author-resource-inventory.json']:
 print('FILE',f); print(Path(f).read_text())
b=json.loads(Path('input/raw-binding352189.json').read_text()); raw=base64.b64decode(b['raw_base64']); original=Path('input/original352189.jsonl').read_bytes(); literal=json.loads(Path('input/literal352189.json').read_text())
print('BINDING',json.dumps({'raw_sha_matches':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==b['raw_sha256'],'saved_original_equals_raw':original==raw,'raw_object_equals_literal':json.loads(raw)==literal,'statement_sha_matches':hashlib.sha256(literal['statement'].encode()).hexdigest()==b['statement_sha256']}))
for f,pages in [('gorenstein',(6,9)),('normality',(6,7))]:
 z=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','-f',str(pages[0]),'-l',str(pages[1]),'input/'+f+'.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=20)
 print('PDF EXTRACT',f,pages); print(z.stdout)
